base_uri.description: base_uri is used be token uri when not set during mint. The token_uri rule is: If TokenUri is set separately during mint, use the TokenUri set during mint, otherwise use base_uri. The scan's parsing of token_uri follows the erc1155 specification, see https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-1155 metadata section. for example: https://token-cdn-domain/{id}.json would be replaced with https://token-cdn-domain/000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000004cce0.json if the client is referring to token ID 314592/0x4CCE0.
